# The Edge Line

*Haldor's crews cut only at the forest edge now. Stand at the last stump to see where the line is, then clear 50 monsters from Strandwood Edge.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Haldor](../npcs/haldor_timber.md) |
| Level | 22 |
| Leads to | [Word for Tamsin](../quests/haldor_word_for_tamsin.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach the last stump in [Gull Heath](../maps/gull_heath.md)
2. Defeat 50 monsters in [Strandwood Edge](../maps/strandwood_edge.md)

## Rewards

- 2,300 EXP
- 880 mesos
- [Brodie's Smoked Fish](../items/brodies_smoked_fish.md) x5
- +20 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Haldor](../npcs/haldor_timber.md)
